Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Component: Steering box

  • Fault: The vehicle experiences occasional steering wheel stiffness, accompanied by the power steering warning light coming on and an audible warning sound in the passenger compartment.

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics: One or more of the following:
    • U0428 (Steering angle – Sensor signal fault)
    • B2000 (Power steering control unit – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty steering box

• Action: Check that the steering box is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component in question consists of: electric motor, steering box and electronic control unit; it is located on the underside of the vehicle, between the engine and the passenger compartment.
